StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.rationale: CORRECT SLOT, and unusually easy to get right because NoBlockPower.cs:22-28 has NO participants filter at all -- it decrements whenever side == CombatSide.Enemy, regardless of who owns it. Hook.AfterSideTurnEnd for the enemy side is Hook.AfterTurnEnd at CombatManager.cs:1256, and the sim's on_enemy_side_end (combat.py) is that slot. Identical shape to audit/records/power/colossus.json's and audit/records/power/diamond_diadem's. The sim's Power._tick (powers.py) decrements the field and _expires at <= 0 where C# routes through PowerCmd.Decrement -> ModifyAmount -> ShouldRemoveDueToAmount (PowerCmd.cs:215-250); PowerCmd.Decrement, NOT TickDownDuration, so neither side honours SkipNextDurationTick. Observationally identical -- ModifyAmount's only unconditional modifier leg is Hook.ModifyPowerAmountReceived (PowerCmd.cs:234), whose ported listeners are ArtifactPower (Debuff-only) and RuinedHelmet (StrengthPower-only). Same mechanism and same verdict as audit/records/power/colossus.json's AfterSideTurnEnd guard, per binding rule 3.

ModifyBlockMultiplicative.rationale: Returns 0 for the owner's card-sourced block and 1 otherwise. All three C# guards are present, one of them structurally: target != base.Owner (NoBlockPower.cs:32-35 vs powers.py), cardSource == null (:40-43 vs :3676 `card is not None`), and props.HasFlag(ValueProp.Unpowered) (:36-39), which the sim gets from BlockCmd.apply itself -- cmds.py gates BOTH block-modifier families behind is_powered_attack(props), the same Move-and-not-Unpowered rule, so unpowered block never reaches this hook. That is why power/plating's and power/toric_toughness's Unpowered block correctly ignores No Block on both sides. 0.0 is dyadic, so this power does not widen hook_dispatch's G9 (executed: py audit/tools/power_census.py multipliers).

guards.rationale: hooks.py multiplies every listener's factor together and cmds.py applies the product once, where C# threads a running decimal (Hook.cs:1320-1337). hook_dispatch's G9 owns this and settled by execution that the BLOCK site is dormant because every ported block factor is binary-exact; 0.0 is one of them. Not re-verdicted here per binding rule 3. Note 0.0 is also absorbing, so No Block wins over power/unmovable's 2.0 under either aggregation shape.
The only ported applier is the Colorless skill Panic Button (cards/colorless_skills.py, self._turns with applier=ctx.player). No AscensionHelper call in NoBlockPower.cs.
